settings.description: Angelico by Mhd Al Sousi. Bespoke tailoring and luxury menswear.

stages.title: The Shirt
stages.text: Two fold Egyptian cotton, hand set collar, mother of pearl buttons.

stages.title: The Tie
stages.text: Seven fold silk, cut on the bias so it falls with quiet weight.

stages.title: The Jacket
stages.text: Full floating canvas. Lapels drawn from the Angelico mark.

stages.title: The Finish
stages.text: Horn buttons, a folded silk square. Nothing loud. Nothing missing.

manifesto.text: A suit is not worn. It is inhabited. At Angelico every garment begins with the man who will carry it, his posture, his stride, the way he enters a room. We cut for that moment.

items.title: Bespoke Suits
items.text: Cut from a pattern drafted for you alone.
items.alt: Navy three piece bespoke suit with gold tie

items.title: Evening & Tuxedo
items.text: Silk peak lapels for the hours after dark.
items.alt: Midnight navy tuxedo with peak satin lapels and bow tie

items.title: Shirting
items.text: Sea island cotton, hand finished buttonholes.
items.alt: Crisp white dress shirt with gold silk tie

items.title: Outerwear
items.text: Cashmere overcoats built to outlast seasons.
items.alt: Navy double breasted wool overcoat with silk scarf

items.title: Accessories
items.alt: Gold cufflink, silk tie and paisley pocket square

items.title: Footwear
items.text: Goodyear welted oxfords in burnished calf.
items.alt: Brown brogue oxfords with navy trousers and patterned socks

atelier.title: From first measure to final press.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We discuss occasion, lifestyle and the cloth that suits both. Over three hundred bunches from the finest mills.

steps.title: Measurement
steps.text: Every slope of the shoulder, every turn of the stance recorded and drafted into a personal paper pattern.

steps.title: Fittings
steps.text: A basted fitting, a forward fitting, a finished fitting. The garment learns your body in stages.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Pressed by hand, presented in our garment carrier, and kept on file for every commission after.
